  • This page checks for an updated card database only when you click Check for update - it never polls in the background.
  • SK% shows the EV bonus provided by this card's score skill.
  • Red text indicates the member has graduated.
  • Add/Remove owned cards: switch into Add mode and click the appropriate button on a card.
  • Upgrade owned cards: to upgrade a card to its SSR+, click the ↑ Upgrade button - it shows up right in View mode on any owned card that has a "+" available.
  • Song and Center Skill support selecting multiple values (ctrl/cmd-click, or shift-click for a range).
  • Owned marks are stored only in this browser - nothing is uploaded or synced anywhere.
  • Warning: clearing your browser data clears this info too. Use the hub's Export/Import buttons (top of the page) to save a backup file covering this and every other tab, and load it back.
  • The Center Skill filter groups S.teller/Veaut-style cards by the text before their "+" (e.g. "Da85%+<mechanic text>" filters under "Da85%"), not as one-off categories.
  • Pull order: tick it to swap the Owned column for the position each owned card was added in (#1 = first). Click the column header to sort by it. Cards get their number when you mark them owned, so mark a new batch in the order you actually pulled it; an upgraded card keeps its base card's number.
  • An owned card shows — when no order was ever recorded for it - marks that arrived in bulk, from a save file or the bulk-add grid. Nothing is guessed on your behalf; give it a position in the dialog below.
  • Edit pull order opens a dialog where you can fix a sequence - drag rows, or type a new position into a row's number box. Cards with no position wait at the top of that list until you give them one. Nothing is saved until you press Save order.
